Weak solutions for a system of quasilinear elliptic equations
M. A. Ragusaa and A. Razanib
aDepartment of Mathematics, University of Catania, Viale Andrea Doria

razani@sci.ikiu.ac.ir
A system of quasilinear elliptic equations on an unbounded domain
is considered. The existence of a sequence of radially symmetric
weak solutions is proved via variational methods.
Keywords: Sequence of solutions, elliptic problem, p-Laplacian, varia-
tional methods.
2010 Mathematics subject classiﬁcation: 35J20, 34B10, 35J50.
